mapper.select: SELECT SUGGESTED_ROUND FROM ( SELECT gm.MEMBER_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NVL(rs.OVERDUE_PROB, 0.35) DESC, gm.MEMBER_ID ASC) AS SUGGESTED_ROUND FROM GYE_MEMBER gm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER_ID, OVERDUE_PROB, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MEMBER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM RISK_SCORE ) rs ON gm.MEMBER_ID = rs.MEMBER_ID AND rs.RN = 1 WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYOUT_REQUEST SET ROUND_NO = #{roundNo}, REASON = #{reason}, AI_SUGGESTED_ROUND = #{aiSuggestedRound}, CREATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PAYOUT_REQUEST_ID = #{payoutRequestId}
UPDATE PAYOUT_REQUEST SET STATUS = #{status}, DECIDED_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED') THEN SYSDATE ELSE DECIDED_AT END WHERE PAYOUT_REQUEST_ID = #{payoutRequestId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONSENT WHERE CONSENT_TYPE = 'ORDER' AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND AGREED_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_MEMBER WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND PAYOUT_ROUND IS NULL

SELECT pr.PAYOUT_REQUEST_ID AS payoutRequestId, pr.GROUP_ID AS groupId, pr.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS memberName, pr.ROUND_NO AS roundNo, pr.REASON AS reason, pr.AI_SUGGESTED_ROUND AS aiSuggestedRound, pr.STATUS AS status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONSENT c WHERE c.CONSENT_TYPE = 'ORDER' AND c.TARGET_ID = pr.PAYOUT_REQUEST_ID AND c.AGREED_YN = 'Y') AS agreedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_MEMBER gm WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = pr.GROUP_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND gm.MEMBER_ID != pr.MEMBER_ID) AS targetCount, pr.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, pr.DECIDED_AT AS decidedAt FROM PAYOUT_REQUEST pr JOIN MEMBER m ON pr.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE pr.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} ORDER BY pr.ROUND_NO ASC, pr.CREATED_AT DESC
